versions.content: Handling if EthSwt_MacSecUpdateSecY is called and EthSwtPortMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE Status: DRAFT If EthSwt_MacSecUpdateSecY is called and EthSwtPortMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE of the EthSwtPort identified with the given SwitchPor- tIdx at the EthSwtConfig identified with the given SwitchIdx , then the EthSwt driver shall consider to update the Ethernet switch port that corresponds to the given SwitchPortIdx at the Ethernet switch that corresponds to the given SwitchIdx with the MAC security entity configuration provided via MACsecCfgPtr and consider to establish a transmit secure channel with the transmission secure channel id given with TxSci and return with E_OK .
